corrections_applied.action: S015 had no approved screen text, so S014 held 19.4 s. Bullet matching now understands numbers and units ('650 nanometre' = '650 nm'); S015 shows its approved slide bullet.
Removed the decorative GYMRAMP mark from the base layer: it sat under every opaque scene (occluded) and failed WCAG contrast.
Same mark touched the reserved caption band; removed with it.

Evidence card S010 showed '48 hours' above a finding that, as displayed, reported a null result at one hour. Headline figures are now taken only from the text on the card, and the validator rejects a figure the finding does not contain.
'Sources and next step' appeared twice in a row (section title then outro). A section title followed by a card with the same title is now left out.
